feeds.title: Film Shortage Blog
feeds.description: Film Shortage is an online cinema showcasing the best short films online. We feature mind-blowing new shorts every day with fresh new trailers and tips.

feeds.title: Indie Shorts Mag
feeds.description: Indie Shorts Mag caters to filmmakers and cinephiles alike as a medium to connect over their common passion beyond the confines of any language. Besides hosting reviews, interviews, tutorials, and news related to short films, indie films, foreign-language films & festivals; they also work around the web series and music videos circuit.

feeds.title: Short of the Week
feeds.description: Short of the Week finds the web's best cinematic short films and brings them to you, along with expert criticism from our staff of short film reviewers. Don't waste time finding the hidden gems on the big video sites, Short of the Week is like a permanent film festival.

feeds.title: Shortfundly Blog
feeds.description: Shortfundly is an online media company who believes in making the best Indian films accessible and great stories to be shared. Our vision is to continually grow the community of short film audience to enable a wide and accessible market reach for short films and become the leading micro-cinema/shortfilm platform for India.

feeds.title: Aesthetica Short Film Festival
feeds.description: The Aesthetica Short Film Festival (ASFF) is an international film festival which takes place annually in York, UK, at the beginning of November. It is a celebration of independent film from around the world, and an outlet for supporting and championing filmmaking. Aesthetica Short Film Festival blog provides information about the festival, the events, latest news, interviews, guests, feature stories and more.

feeds.title: Short Shorts
feeds.description: Short Shorts is a comprehensive short film brand. It leads the film culture through various means such as its screening events, film distribution, production, and collaboration work with companies and administrative offices. While supporting young creators through various activities and events, we broaden the field of short films.

feeds.title: Festivals at Festhome Blog
feeds.description: Festhome is an online short film submission platform.It provides a platform where filmmakers can send their works to the festivals. These festivals have a private area that allow tallowsualize, manage the film information and control the selection process separately.

feeds.title: Top Shorts Blog
feeds.description: Known as the world's leading online film festival, Top Shorts is one of the best-reviewed festivals on Film freeway, with over 200 five-star reviews. Top Shorts Blog shares information about awards, nominations, winners, film reviews, interviews, feature stories and more. The categories at the festival are Narrative, Web Series, Animation, Documentary, Indie, Inspirational, Experimental, Music Video and Micro Film.

feeds.title: Short Films Matter
feeds.description: At Short Films Matter, we believe in the power of storytelling in its most concise and captivating form the short film. Our platform is dedicated to celebrating the artistry and creativity of filmmakers from every corner of the globe, providing a space where independent voices can be heard and appreciated.

feeds.title: Screen Critix » Short Film Review
feeds.description: The following section of Screen Critix features reviews of Short Films. Screen Critix is an entertainment site that covers a large range of mediums including but not limited to movies, anime, gaming, TV, and even manga.

feeds.title: The Blogging Banshee » Short Films
feeds.description: Get the latest short film reviews by The Blogging Banshee. My name is Molly Henery. Ever since my sister forced me to watch A Nightmare on Elm Street at the tender age of four years old, I have been hooked on horror movies. Now, I'm a Tomatometer-approved film critic and freelance entertainment writer.

feeds.title: FilmCarnage.com » Short Film
feeds.description: The aim of Film Carnage has become more and more about celebrating indie films. Whether it's a short or a feature, the goal is simply to help filmmakers by highlighting the amazing work they're doing and giving honest, constructive reviews. Read short film reviews in the following segment of FilmCarnage.

feeds.title: Glasgow Short Film Festival News
feeds.description: Glasgow Short Film Festival, the largest competitive short film festival in Scotland, champions new film talent by providing an annual showcase and meeting point for new and established Scottish and international filmmakers, industry delegates, and the local audience.

feeds.title: Studentfilms.com Blog
feeds.description: StudentFilms.com's blogs page is a vibrant hub where student filmmakers and composers share personal project updates, reflections, festival news, and collaborative opportunities in a supportive ad‑free community.

feeds.title: Maximum Z » Short Films
feeds.description: Posts about short films written by Maximum Z

feeds.title: Every Movie Has a Lesson Blog » Short Films
feeds.description: The active and ongoing blog page of 'Every Movie Has a Lesson' containing current movie and film reviews, commentary, editorials, columns, previews, and awards talks.

feeds.title: Cut To The Take » Short Film Reviews
feeds.description: The 'Short Film Reviews' section on Cut to the Take offers concise, insightful critiques of the latest short films—perfect for cinephiles seeking thoughtful, time‑efficient analysis.

feeds.title: Shore Scripts » Short Films
feeds.description: The 'Short Films' section on Shore Scripts showcases opportunities, success stories, and funding opportunities for emerging screenwriters and filmmakers aiming to get their shorts produced and launched at top festivals.

feeds.title: Global Short Film Awards Cannes Blog
feeds.description: The Global Short Film Awards' blog showcases highlights from its annual Cannes gala—celebrating short‑film winners, red‑carpet fashion shows, celebrity guests, and festival partnerships.

feeds.title: Sultan Gill » Short Film
feeds.description: Explore the creative Blog of filmmaking, short films, and screenwriting on SultanGill.in. Discover inspiring stories, practical tips, and behind-the-scenes insights from the heart of independent cinema.

feeds.title: Talking Shorts
feeds.description: Short films are key to cinematic innovation. Because of their brevity, they allow filmmakers to react to the world around them more instinctively and showcase a stunning range of artistic expressions. As a magazine dedicated to short films, Talking Shorts aims to create a wider discourse about this often-overlooked art form.

feeds.title: Weird Short Films Blog
feeds.description: Weird Short Films is a platform created by filmmaker Christopher Wells that focuses on unusual, bold, and experimental short films across genres like horror, dark comedy, and psychological thrillers. They curate films, host filmmaker challenges, and organize live screening events in Brooklyn, New York.

feeds.title: We Love Short Films Blog
feeds.description: We are film critics who love the art of short film and want to share these special films with the world.

feeds.title: WWCSFF Blog
feeds.description: WWCSFF runs a group of international short film festivals covering comedy, student, experimental and seasonal categories. Their blog features festival updates, winning films, filmmaker highlights and announcements.

feeds.title: NWIFF Blog
feeds.description: NWIFF's blog features essays, interviews and reflections on independent cinema with a strong focus on short films. Their posts explore themes, filmmaker perspectives and creative processes, and they continue to publish active and thoughtful content.

feeds.title: Short Film Central
feeds.description: The international short film database. A hub for filmmakers, film festivals and film fans.

feeds.title: Berlinale Shorts
feeds.description: The short films of the Berlinale Shorts are the unsolicited statements of the cinema. They radiate the full range of colors, stretch the boundaries, and lay down new tracks in the vast field of cinematic possibilities. Berlinale Shorts is open to all genres, styles, and subject matters.

feeds.title: Sofy Blog
feeds.description: Sofy.tv brings the best shorts in the world to your screen. Sofy Blog talks about film festivals, the film industry, short films, and largo films. Follow and stay tuned to read more insights from the industry.

feeds.title: McMinnville Short Film Festival Blog
feeds.description: The MSFF blog helps filmmakers and film lovers unlock the power and purpose of short films. As one of the pre-eminent short film festivals in the world, in our blog, we'll share why we're so passionate about this visual poetry form of art. Each month, we'll feature a different guest writer to share their experiences with a short film. From filmmakers, film lovers, and professionals in the film industry, our film community has endless stories to tell, expertise to share, and information to interest.

feeds.title: ROS Film Festival Blog
feeds.description: ROS Film Festival is the 1st robotic online short film festival. On our blog, we publish articles on new releases, events, screenings, and more for our short film enthusiasts to stay updated on the latest news.

feeds.title: Shortfilm.de
feeds.description: The Short Film Magazine is your source to read about the latest & most trendy news in the short film industry. The magazine features articles and write-ups where the experts share their views and opinions about the industry, films, and more.

feeds.title: Short Movie Club Film Festival Blog
feeds.description: Filmmaker Mediazone is the Short Movie Club online magazine. The magazine targets filmmakers and cinema lovers. It contains research, studies, and interviews on the world of short films. Short Movie Club aims to promote unpurified through the festival's films. They collect films and make it their mission to show programmes to a wide audience in art centres and cinemas schools as often as possible.

feeds.title: New York No Limits Film Series Blog
feeds.description: New York No Limits (NYNL) is a film-series and community dedicated to screening bold, independent short and feature films. Their blog tracks their Art of the Short events, summit lineups, and filmmaker stories.

feeds.title: The Film Magazine » Short Film
feeds.description: The Film Magazine's Short Film section offers thoughtful reviews, features, and critical analysis of short films covering a wide range of genres from horror and documentary to award contenders. As an independent UK-based publication run by film scholars and critics, it explores the artistry, impact, and storytelling strength of short-form cinema.

feeds.title: Norwich Film Festival
feeds.description: Norwich Film Festival is committed to showcasing the very best of independent short film. We want to provide a platform for creative, high quality short films from both local and international filmmakers.

feeds.title: FirstShowing » Short Film
feeds.description: FirstShowing connects Short Film lovers to the industry with its expert-written reviews, news, articles, and more. We provide for free to anyone with internet access: the latest movie trailers, movie reviews, interviews, opinions, updates, and everything else related to the cinematic experience straight from Hollywood and beyond.

feeds.title: Show Me Shorts Film Festival
feeds.description: Show Me Shorts is Aotearoa New Zealand's leading international short film festival. We are a competitive Academy Awards-accredited festival that screens in cinemas nationwide each Spring.

feeds.title: Ottawa Short Films
feeds.description: Browse or search our database of short films created by Ottawa filmmakers. Rewatch old favourites, or discover new talent in our nation's capital!
